objectives.en: Find the median of raw, discrete and continuous data
Find the quartiles Q₁ and Q₃
State the merits and demerits of the median

narration.en: Line up the class from shortest to tallest. The student standing exactly in the middle has the median height. One very tall student cannot change who stands in the middle.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿಯನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಎತ್ತರದಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎತ್ತರದವರೆಗೆ ಸಾಲಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ. ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತವರ ಎತ್ತರವೇ ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ. ಒಬ್ಬ ತುಂಬಾ ಎತ್ತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಮಧ್ಯದವರನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಲಾರ.

body.en: The median is the middle value when the data are arranged in order; half the values lie below it and half above. Raw data: the ((n + 1)/2)th value; if n is even, the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th values. Discrete series: find cumulative frequencies and the value whose cf first reaches (N + 1)/2. Continuous series: locate the median class where cf first reaches N/2, then use the formula, where L is its lower boundary, cf the cumulative frequency before it, f its frequency and h its width.
body.kn: ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ ಎಂದರೆ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದಾಗ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಮೌಲ್ಯ. ಕಚ್ಚಾ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ: (n + 1)/2 ನೇ ಮೌಲ್ಯ. ನಿರಂತರ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ: cf ಮೊದಲು N/2 ತಲುಪುವ ವರ್ಗವೇ ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ ವರ್ಗ; ಸೂತ್ರ Median = L + (N/2 − cf)/f × h.

narration.en: The median is the middle value when the data are arranged in order; half the values lie below it and half above. Raw data: the ((n + 1)/2)th value; if n is even, the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th values. Discrete series: find cumulative frequencies and the value whose cf first reaches (N + 1)/2. Continuous series: locate the median class where cf first reaches N/2, then use the formula, where L is its lower boundary, cf the cumulative frequency before it, f its frequency and h its width.
narration.kn: ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ ಎಂದರೆ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದಾಗ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಮೌಲ್ಯ. ಕಚ್ಚಾ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ: (n + 1)/2 ನೇ ಮೌಲ್ಯ. ನಿರಂತರ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ: cf ಮೊದಲು N/2 ತಲುಪುವ ವರ್ಗವೇ ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ ವರ್ಗ; ಸೂತ್ರ Median = L + (N/2 − cf)/f × h.

say.en: N over 2 is 20. The first cf to reach 20 is 25, so the median class is 20 to 30.
In the same way, Q1 = 16.25 at N/4 = 10, and Q3 = 35 at 3N/4 = 30.

narration.en: On the board: Median of a continuous series.

body.en: Quartiles divide the data into four equal parts. $Q_1 = L + \frac{N/4 - cf}{f} \times h$ and $Q_3 = L + \frac{3N/4 - cf}{f} \times h$, using the classes where cf first reaches N/4 and 3N/4; $Q_2$ is the median. (Deciles and percentiles divide the data into 10 and 100 parts.) Merits of the median: not affected by extreme values, can be found for open-end classes and graphically (ogives), suits qualitative data that can be ranked. Demerits: not based on all values, needs arranging, not suitable for algebraic treatment.
body.kn: ಚತುರ್ಥಕಗಳು ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಮಭಾಗಗಳಾಗಿ ವಿಭಜಿಸುತ್ತವೆ: Q₁ ಗೆ N/4, Q₃ ಗೆ 3N/4. ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕದ ಗುಣಗಳು: ತೀವ್ರ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿತವಲ್ಲ, ತೆರೆದ ತುದಿ ವರ್ಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ. ದೋಷ: ಎಲ್ಲ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಧಾರಿತವಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: Quartiles divide the data into four equal parts. Q1 = L + N/4 - cff  times  h and Q3 = L + 3N/4 - cff  times  h, using the classes where cf first reaches N/4 and 3N/4; Q2 is the median. (Deciles and percentiles divide the data into 10 and 100 parts.) Merits of the median: not affected by extreme values, can be found for open-end classes and graphically (ogives), suits qualitative data that can be ranked. Demerits: not based on all values, needs arranging, not suitable for algebraic treatment.

points.en: Median: middle value of ordered data.
Q₁ uses N/4 and Q₃ uses 3N/4.
Median suits open-end classes and is not hurt by extremes.

narration.en: Recap. Median: middle value of ordered data. Continuous: Median = L + (N/2 − cf)/f × h. Q₁ uses N/4 and Q₃ uses 3N/4. Median suits open-end classes and is not hurt by extremes.
